'''Felshade''', also known as '''Bog Mawvorr''', was a hostile, [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] subspecies of [[Mawvorr]], found in the [[Endless Swamp]] on [[Zakuul]]<ref name="felshade" /> and on [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]]<ref name="dxun">{{TORcite|type=operation|Nature of Progress}}</ref>.

Felshades had dark grey skin while their eyes were glowing orange.<ref name="felshade" /> The plates on their backs and on their heads, unlike chromatophore plates on relative [[crysfang]]s, did not glow. Another distinctive trait of felshades was the absence of skin on their head appendages which appeared similar to horns.<ref name="felshade" />
